summary: Extremely bullish. Fed Chair Powell delivers clearest rate cut signal yet at Jackson Hole: 'The time has come for policy to adjust.' This is the single most anticipated macro catalyst of 2024 H2. Combined with August 21 nonfarm payrolls downward revision of 818,000 jobs (largest since 2009), the case for a September rate cut is ironclad — CME FedWatch shows 89%+ probability. Risk-on regime confirmed. Prior day (Aug 22) saw all three major indexes close green on FOMC minutes confirming dovish tilt. After-hours earnings from WDAY, ROST, CAVA all beat and raised. This is a textbook momentum-long day: dovish Fed pivot + strong earnings + improving breadth + rate-sensitive sector rotation.

scenarios.trade: Earnings gap-ups with raised guidance and analyst upgrades have strong follow-through on day 1. The 30% margin target was the 'big upside surprise' per analysts. Software sector benefiting from rate cut narrative. Volume will be elevated, providing liquidity for clean entry.

scenarios.implication: Gap fills are common in SaaS names. If broader market sells off on hawkish Powell surprise, WDAY could give back gains. Subscription revenue growth decelerating from 17% could weigh on forward estimates.

scenarios.trade: NVDA is the consensus long into earnings week. Rate cut signal amplifies the bull case by reducing discount rates on high-growth cash flows. The stock recovered from the early August selloff and is building a base. Institutional positioning ahead of Aug 28 earnings will create sustained buying pressure throughout the day.

scenarios.implication: NVDA has already run significantly from the August 5 low. Earnings expectations are extremely elevated — even a beat may not be enough if guidance disappoints. The stock is pricing in perfection. Any macro shock could trigger rapid deleveraging.

scenarios.trade: KRE trades at just 10.2x P/E — deep value relative to market. Rate cuts are a structural tailwind that will persist for quarters. The ETF provides diversified exposure without single-stock risk. The magnitude of Aug 23 move (5.5%) with ALL components positive is extremely rare and signals a regime change for the sector.

scenarios.implication: Regional banks still face CRE exposure concerns. NYCB and others have meaningful commercial real estate portfolios that could deteriorate in a recession. If the labor market weakens faster than expected, loan losses could offset NIM improvement.

scenarios.trade: Homebuilders are trading at reasonable valuations despite the runup. DHI has pricing power due to its scale and land bank. Lower rates = more buyers qualify for mortgages = higher volumes and potentially higher ASPs. The S&P 1500 Homebuilding Index was up 29% YTD — strong momentum.

scenarios.implication: Homebuilder valuations may already price in rate cuts. Job market weakening (818K payroll revision) could dampen housing demand. Affordability remains stretched in many markets. Some analysts warned the rally 'may have already priced in' the Fed cut.

scenarios.trade: CAVA is the highest-growth restaurant stock in the market. The SSS beat was extraordinary — 14.4% vs 7.9% expected signals the brand is in hypergrowth mode. Combined with Jackson Hole rate cut boost to growth stock multiples, CAVA has both company-specific and macro tailwinds. Post-earnings momentum in high-growth names typically carries for 1-3 days.

scenarios.implication: CAVA trades at an extremely rich valuation. The stock could gap up and then reverse as profit-taking emerges. Restaurant sector faces labor cost headwinds. Single-concept risk — any same-store sales deceleration would be punished harshly at these multiples.

scenarios.trade: IWM provides diversified small-cap exposure without single-stock risk. The 'Great Rotation' from mega-cap to small-cap has been building since July. The payroll revision strengthens the rate cut case while not signaling imminent recession — the goldilocks scenario for small caps. IWM was already in a strong uptrend from the July lows.

scenarios.implication: Small caps are more economically sensitive. If the 818K payroll revision signals a genuine labor market deterioration rather than statistical noise, small caps would underperform. Recession fears could quickly reverse the rotation. Goldman Sachs suggested the revision may be overstated by 500K.

scenarios.trade: TSLA has high beta to risk-on moves and Fed dovishness. The stock is recovering from the early August selloff and has momentum. Lower rates are a genuine demand catalyst for EVs, not just a sentiment play. The combination of macro tailwind + sector rotation + technical recovery creates a favorable setup for a momentum day trade.

scenarios.implication: TSLA fundamentals remain challenged — margin compression, slowing deliveries, increased competition from Chinese EVs. Robotaxi narrative is speculative. The stock trades at an extreme premium to traditional auto peers. Any market reversal would hit TSLA harder than most due to high beta.

Multiple analyst upgrades (Deutsche Bank to $275, Citi, Evercore ISI, Piper Sandler all raised targets). The profitability pivot is a structural re-rating catalyst — buy the opening gap and ride institutional accumulation.
